entries.text: Idea: Building a parabolic collector dish for the Little Dart's intake using polished sheet metal from the hangar roof.
Read "Engine List 1 - Atomic Rockets": Using a laser to heat hydrogen could let the Little Dart fly without carrying a massive fuel tank.
scouring technical forums for ion thruster schematics and synthesis methods
entries.why: i need to figure out how to make my own heat-resistant composites so the little dart can actually fly.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "physics are star-bound"
